messages:
Aisha (People Ops): Quick reminder: all-hands this Friday at 09:30 PT. Please bring any questions for the Q&A doc: https://redwoodinternal/ah/qa-1859876543 :loudspeaker:
Aisha (People Ops): Draft agenda (40m): 1) Company state & wins (Ravi) 2) Product deep dive: Optimize rollout and billing (Marta) 3) Runtime reliability highlights (Eli/Hannah) 4) Policy update: data retention proposal (Theo) 5) Live Q&A
Ravi (CEO): Will share progress vs. our quarterly goals and a short customer highlight about latency wins in APAC.
Marta (Product): Demo will show new rate-limit tiers + per-route costing. If you want a route added to demo, comment here.
Eli (Eng): We9ll surface the new KPIs for cache hit-rate and how it affects tail latency. No heavy demos, just screenshots and dashboards.
Hannah (Infra): FYI we'll be rolling a node firmware update Wed night; it shouldn't impact the all-hands but ping me privately if you have Dedicated cluster runs scheduled.
Theo (Legal): I'll present a short overview of the proposed data retention policy (30/90/365 options) and compliance considerations. Would like product feedback in the doc beforehand.
Aisha (People Ops): Captioning will be enabled. If you need ASL or additional accessibility accommodations, reply here and we'll arrange.
--- (after the meeting)
Aisha (People Ops): Thanks everyone who joined  posting notes + recording here. Recording: https://redwoodinternal/ah/recordings/1859876543 (transcript will post shortly)
Ravi (CEO): TL;DR: growth in usage up 23% QoQ, two notable Dedicated renewals, invest in Private go-to-market for regulated customers.
Marta (Product): Beta open for per-route billing; sign-up link in the recording notes at 14:05. Also: rollout staging now supports canary weights and auto-rollback on quality regressions (ticket #PROD-881).
Eli (Eng): Cache hit improvements reduced median p50 generation time by ~6% on our internal benchmarks; tracking follow-up in #eng-runtime. Thanks to the infra and runtime teams for the optimization.
Hannah (Infra): The Wed firmware push completed with no customer impact; small uptick in node mem usage observed and fixed in the follow-up patch (INFRA-672).
Theo (Legal): Data retention proposal summary: recommended default 90 days for quick-turn analytics, opt-in 365 days for enterprise with contractual terms; open comment period for two weeks.
Aisha (People Ops): Action items: 1) Product to publish beta signup and docs (Marta) 2) Eng to post a 1-paragraph note on performance change (Eli) 3) Legal to collect product feedback on retention (Theo) 4) People Ops to publish meeting one-pager + links (Aisha)
TranscriptBot: Transcript available: will attach to the recording page within 2 hours.
Ravi (CEO): Quick ask to the company: please share one customer success story or small win in #general by EOD Monday; we'll share highlights in the next update.
Marta (Product): If you missed the demo, jump to 14:05-21:30 in the recording. Drop follow-up requests in the product follow-up doc.
Aisha (People Ops): Closing note: thanks for keeping Qs concise. If you have follow-ups for any presenter, mention them here or DM. :wave:
